papers.title: Anchor-Free Dense Object Detection at High Input Resolution
papers.abstract: We present an anchor-free detector for natural images, evaluated on COCO object detection benchmarks with a convolutional backbone and a transformer decoder head.
objectives: Remove anchor priors from dense detection
limitations: Detection accuracy degrades sharply for objects smaller than sixteen pixels
Inference throughput falls below real time at high input resolution
Performance drops on heavily occluded pedestrians in crowded street scenes
future_directions: Extend the decoder to exploit temporal context across adjacent video frames

papers.title: Long-Horizon Multiple Object Tracking in Untrimmed Video
papers.abstract: A tracking-by-detection pipeline for natural video that maintains object identity across shot boundaries and long occlusions on MOT benchmarks.
limitations: Identity switches accumulate when objects are occluded for more than forty frames
Inference throughput falls below real time at high input resolution
future_directions: Investigate self-supervised re-identification objectives that need no identity labels

papers.title: A Fast Single-Stage Detector for Edge Deployment
papers.abstract: We describe a single-stage detector optimised for edge hardware and report latency on embedded accelerators for natural image object detection.
objectives: Reduce detector latency on edge hardware
limitations: remains challenging
future work includes

papers.title: A Survey of Convolutional Backbones for Natural Image Recognition
papers.abstract: This survey reviews convolutional and attention-based backbone architectures for natural image classification and object recognition.

papers.title: Latent Diffusion for High-Resolution Natural Image Synthesis
papers.abstract: A latent diffusion model for text-conditioned synthesis of natural images at high resolution, evaluated with FID on standard image generation benchmarks.
limitations: Compositional prompts with several interacting subjects bleed attributes between them
Sampling requires many denoising steps, so generation is slow
future_directions: Distil the sampler so high-resolution synthesis needs far fewer denoising steps

papers.title: Encoder-Decoder Segmentation of Abdominal Organs in Volumetric CT
papers.abstract: We segment abdominal organs in volumetric CT with an encoder-decoder network and report Dice overlap against radiologist reference contours.
limitations: Segmentation accuracy degrades on anatomy underrepresented in the training cohort
The model generalises poorly to scanners and acquisition protocols it never saw in training
Manual voxel-level annotation of volumetric scans is prohibitively expensive to obtain
future_directions: Investigate federated training across hospitals so no patient scans leave their institution

papers.title: Transformer Segmentation of Cardiac Structures in MRI
papers.abstract: A transformer segmentation network for cardiac chambers in MRI, evaluated with Dice and Hausdorff distance against clinical reference contours.
limitations: Segmentation accuracy degrades on anatomy underrepresented in the training cohort
The model generalises poorly to scanners and acquisition protocols it never saw in training
Inter-observer disagreement between radiologists limits the reliability of the reference labels
future_directions: Exploit large volumes of unlabelled clinical scans through self-supervised pretraining

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Tumour Segmentation in Whole-Slide Histopathology
papers.abstract: Semi-supervised tumour segmentation on whole-slide histopathology images, using stain normalisation and reporting Dice against pathologist annotation.
objectives: Segment tumour regions in whole-slide images
limitations: Manual voxel-level annotation of volumetric scans is prohibitively expensive to obtain
Stain normalisation increases training time without markedly improving overlap scores
Inter-observer disagreement between radiologists limits the reliability of the reference labels
future_directions: Explore whether foundation models pretrained on histopathology transfer across staining protocols

papers.title: Chest Radiograph Classification with Calibrated Uncertainty
papers.abstract: We classify thoracic disease on chest radiographs and calibrate predictive uncertainty, reporting AUC and subgroup fairness against hospital records.
limitations: The classifier underdiagnoses specific patient subgroups more often than the cohort average
Restricted to five thoracic disease categories, so other clinical findings are unaddressed
future_directions: Audit subgroup calibration prospectively across multiple hospital sites

papers.title: A Review of Registration Methods for Multimodal Clinical Imaging
papers.abstract: A review of deformable and rigid registration methods for aligning multimodal clinical images such as CT, MRI and PET.

papers.title: Trustworthy Uncertainty Estimation for Clinical Organ Segmentation
papers.abstract: We study trustworthy uncertainty estimation for organ segmentation in clinical CT and MRI, reporting Dice and calibration against radiologist reference contours.
objectives: Estimate segmentation uncertainty for clinical use
limitations: Segmentation accuracy degrades on anatomy underrepresented in the training cohort
Predicted uncertainty is poorly calibrated on pathological anatomy
future_directions: Validate uncertainty estimates against radiologist confidence in a reader study

papers.title: A Note on Partial Sums of Divisor-Bounded Multiplicative Functions
papers.abstract: We prove an asymptotic estimate for partial sums of divisor-bounded multiplicative functions, assuming a growth condition on the associated Dirichlet series.
objectives: Estimate partial sums of multiplicative functions
limitations: Only applies to divisor-bounded multiplicative functions
Assumes specific growth rates for the associated partial sums

papers.title: Robust Stability of Moving-Horizon Estimators for Nonlinear Systems
papers.abstract: We analyse robust stability of moving-horizon state estimators for Lipschitz nonlinear dynamical systems under imperfect cost minimisation.
limitations: Imperfect minimisation of the cost function is rarely addressed in the literature
Robust stability of fast moving-horizon estimators remains challenging
